scope: Atomic phase song quota and immediate admin part-release draft reset

new_condition_checks: Actual three-song UI submit at limit two changes no slots, versions, saved answers or comments
Quota error keeps all unsent choices, answer and comment available for correction
Quota rejection displays an error, not a partial-success message
Reducing the same draft to two songs registers both and saves its answer
Rejected reasonless release resets visible mode/reason but leaves the assignment unchanged
Successful real admin release clears mode/reason and releases only the captured selected slot
Admin release reset does not overwrite the subject’s saved answer

test_harness_adjustment: Initial browser run stopped after 139 checks because the new helper did not close the existing result dialog. Added normal close-button interaction; restarted from a fresh DB. No product/assertion weakening.
limitations: Local synthetic SQLite, localhost SMTP and virtual authenticators only.
DXP deployment and physical-device acceptance are not independently observed.
No new migration or CD mechanism changes.
